scheme_name: Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Must have at least 75% marks in graduation/postgraduate studies in the relevant subject
Must have secured admission to a study program abroad
Must have qualified for international tests such as GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, or IELTS
For PhD applicants, must have either two years of teaching experience or an M.Phil degree in the relevant subject from a recognized university or government college in Madhya Pradesh
Age limit: under 25 years for postgraduate studies and under 35 years for PhD research
benefits_summary: Provides up to $40,000 (or equivalent) annually for study abroad, covering expenses and an additional $2,000 for academic materials, subject to a bond.
